title: Hová? and megy: megyek, mész, megy

sections.title: Asking and answering
sections.content: *Hová?* asks where someone is going. The answer names the place with *-ba* or *-be* and stands right before the verb, in the same spot where *Hová* stood in the question: *Hová mész?* – *A parkba megyek.* The verb for “go” changes with the person. Learn these three forms as they are; other verbs come later.

items.english: I am going to the office.
Meg is going to the bedroom.

sections.content: *Hol vagy?* and *Hová mész?* are different questions. The first asks where you are right now, and the answer ends in *-ban/-ben*. The second asks where you are heading, and the answer ends in *-ba/-be*. *Hová* is also written *hova*; both are correct.
